description: HUM Network Limited is a Pakistani media company operating television, news, film and digital businesses, and describes itself as one of the largest broadcasting brands with a following among the South Asian diaspora. Its brands span entertainment (HUM TV, HUM Masala, HUM Sitaray, HUM Pashto 1), news (HUM News), film (HUM Films), digital media, PR and publication, HUM Mart and Ten Sports. The company is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
